geography: As reported; the revenue tables do not label a territory (Gralise became commercially available in October 2011 following U.S. FDA approval)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 022544 ... Gralise (gabapentin) Tablets 300 mg and 600 mg ... it is approved, effective on the date of this letter (electronic signature dated 01/28/2011)

launch_evidence.quote: We made Gralise commercially available in October 2011, following its U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval in January 2011.

series_end_reason: Assertio sold Gralise to Alvogen on January 10, 2020 (2019Q4 release: 'On January 10, 2020, the Company completed the sale of Gralise to Alvogen'). The 2020Q1 release prints a Gralise row of 547 (thousands) for the stub, which is not a quarter of ownership and is not in the series; no later Assertio release prints Gralise. The acquirer is a private company and no document with a Gralise sales figure was found for it.
notes: Depomed's own 'Gralise' product-sales line, 2011Q4-2019Q4, no gaps. 2011Q4-2013Q1 are prose figures in USD millions (revenue recognized on a prescription basis until the change to a sell-in model in 2012Q4, which added a one-time $1.6 million); 2013Q2 onward are table rows in USD thousands. 2017Q1 uses the restated 17,600 from the 2018Q1 release's prior-year column (the quarter's own release printed 18,552); the series then reconciles to each printed full year: 2013 36,188 (6.1 + 8.554 + 9.812 + 11.733 = 36.199), 2014 60,411, 2015 81,054, 2016 88,446, 2017 77,034, 2018 58,077, 2019 63,124. 2012: 1.75 + 3.2 + 4.8 + 7.6 = 17.35 against the printed full year 17.3 (the first-quarter figure is printed to two decimals). Gabapentin's first approval was 1993 (Initial U.S. Approval of the Gralise label); first_approval_year here is that of this product's NDA 022544.
search_log: EDGAR submissions CIK 1005201 (Depomed / Assertio Therapeutics, to 2020-05) and CIK 1808665 (new Assertio Holdings, from 2020-08): listed Item 2.02 8-K and 8-K/A; opened every earnings-release exhibit 2011Q3-2020Q1. The 2018-08-17 8-K/A repeats the 2018-08-08 table; the original was used.
2011Q4-2013Q1 releases carry no Gralise table row; the figure is stated in text (searched each release for 'Gralise' sentences).
The 2014-02-25 8-K is a preliminary Q4 2013 product-sales total with no Gralise figure; the 2014-03-12 release is the fourth-quarter release used.

Cross-check: for each year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year figure printed in the fourth-quarter release (see notes). The 2017Q1 original value (18,552) did not reconcile; the restated 17,600 does.

Gralise was sold in January 2020; the 2020Q1 Assertio release prints a Gralise row of 547 and was not used. Almatica / Alvogen: no public document with a Gralise sales figure was found (private company); not pursued further.
